steps.name: Prepare a release
steps.run:
git config --global user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
git config --global user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
git config --global url."https://x-access-token:${{ steps.get-github-token.outputs.token }}@github.com/".insteadOf "git@github.com:"

devbox run make prepare-release

if [[ `git -C ./workspace/foundation-sdk/ status --porcelain` ]]; then
  echo "has_changes=yes" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "has_changes=no" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Generate diff
steps.run:
diff \
  --new-file \
  --unidirectional-new-file \
  --color=never \
  --unified \
  --recursive \
  --exclude='.git' \
  --exclude='.cog' \
  --exclude='typescript/dist' \
  --exclude='scripts*' \
  --exclude='gradle.properties' \
  --exclude='pyproject.toml' \
  --exclude='package.json' \
  --exclude='yarn.lock' \
  --exclude='*.md' \
  --exclude='diff.patch' \
  --exclude='.release' \
  ./ /tmp/foundation-workspace-current/foundation-sdk/ > diff.patch || true # diff returns 1 if the two targets have differences

steps.name: Preview diff
steps.run:
cat <<'EOF' > preview.md
<!-- grafana-foundation-sdk-diff-preview-marker -->

**Note:** the diff show code changes that would be introduced by this PR. Changes already on `${{ steps.latest_branch.outputs.ref }}` are excluded.

[See full diff](${{ steps.artifact-upload-step.outputs.artifact-url }}).

<details>
<summary>

### 🔎 Changes to `${{ steps.latest_branch.outputs.ref }}`

</summary>

```patch
EOF

cat diff.patch >> preview.md

cat <<'EOF' >> preview.md
```
</details>
EOF
